title: 第一卷 第9章 全是野路子的顾尘第一卷 第10章 玄冰幽兰破境锻体
content_zh:
“二哥！”
人群中，那五名吴家子弟对视了一眼，犹豫了半瞬，还是出手了。
二哥不是亲二哥。
生死他们不关心。
可，若吴飞真的被人打死，还是当着这么多人的面打死，他们吴家的脸，也就丢尽了！
五人同时出手！
劲风接连扫来！亦是带着隐隐的风雷之音！
顾尘心中一凛！
心神顿时从那种溪流绵绵不绝的状态中退了出来，强行止住了拳势，站在原地，暂时不再出手。
几人也没敢追。
谁知道顾尘还能不能再出三百拳？
“你……你……”
从溪流之势中脱身的吴飞盯着顾尘，刚要说什么，身体一晃，面色一白，当场吐了几大口血！
众人心里一跳！
伤得这么重？
再看顾尘，他们对其实力又有了个新的认知！
以气海境的修为！
差点把一个锻体巅峰打死？
这种事，他们见所未见，闻所未闻！
一道道目光投落在顾尘身上，皆是带着惊疑忌惮之意，顾尘却好似没察觉到，只是盯着两只完全没了感觉，颤抖不停的胳膊，目光亮得吓人！

严格来说。
这是他踏入修行以来，第一次正面硬碰硬跟人动手！
而效果——
也彻底验证了灵溪诀后面那几句话的正确定！
以凡体，战天骄！
称吴飞为天骄，可能除了水分还是水分，可他这个被老头子亲口断定为平平无奇的凡体，却是实打实的！
“再来？”
经脉内的灵溪依旧是安安静静。
他的目光却是灼灼如火，抬头看向吴飞，跃跃欲试道：“打不死你，小爷就是你爹！”
吴飞突然攥紧了拳头！
他没回应！
他已经怕了！
因为再继续下去，他真可能会被顾尘打死！
可越是如此！
他越是忌惮，越是嫉妒，越是恐惧……恐惧到他根本不想让顾尘多活一刻！
“实不相瞒！”
深深吸了口气。
他阴戾的目光扫过场间众人，咬牙道：“半日前我初见他，他不过区区一个山野贱民，半日之后……却已然踏入气海之境，至于实力……你们也看到了！”
恩？
众人听得心里一动！
content_en:
"Second brother!"
In the crowd, the five Wu family disciples looked at each other, hesitated for a moment, and then took action.
The second brother is not the second brother.
They don't care about life or death.
However, if Wu Fei was really beaten to death, or in front of so many people, the Wu family would be completely disgraced!
Five people took action at the same time!
Strong winds come one after another! It also carries the faint sound of wind and thunder!
Gu Chen's heart trembled!
His mind immediately retreated from the state of the endless stream, he forcibly stopped his punches, stood there, and stopped taking action for the time being.
Few people dared to chase him.
Who knows if Gu Chen can punch another 300 times?
"You...you..."
Wu Fei, who had escaped from the flow of the stream, stared at Gu Chen. Just as he was about to say something, his body swayed, his face turned pale, and he vomited a lot of blood on the spot!
Everyone's heart skipped a beat!
Injured so badly?
Looking at Gu Chen again, they had a new understanding of his strength!
With the cultivation level of Qi Sea Realm!
Almost beat a peak bodybuilder to death?
They have never seen or heard of such a thing!
Eyes fell on Gu Chen one after another, all with a look of surprise and fear, but Gu Chen didn't seem to notice, he just stared at the two arms that were completely numb and trembling, his eyes were so bright and scary!
Strictly speaking.
This is the first time since he started practicing Buddhism that he has faced off against someone head-on!
And the effect——
It also completely verified the correctness of the sentences at the end of Lingxi Jue!
Use your mortal body to fight against the genius!
Calling Wu Fei a genius may mean that he is nothing but water, but his mortal body, which the old man personally judged to be ordinary, is the real deal!
"Come again?"
The spiritual stream in the meridians is still quiet.
His eyes were burning like fire. He looked up at Wu Fei and said eagerly: "If I can't kill you, I will be your father!"
Wu Fei suddenly clenched his fists!
He didn't respond!
He is already afraid!
Because if he continues, he might really be beaten to death by Gu Chen!
But the more so!
The more fearful he became, the more jealous he became, and the more afraid he became... so afraid that he didn't even want to let Gu Chen live for a moment longer!
"It's true!"
Take a deep breath.
His sinister eyes swept over the crowd, and he gritted his teeth and said, "When I first met him half a day ago, he was just a pariah in the mountains. Half a day later...he has already entered the realm of Qi Sea. As for his strength...you have seen it too!"
Huh?
Everyone was moved when they heard it!
